name: Black Lotus Fort
description: A pirate hold on basalt cliffs, taken by Kavik in a night assault during a thunderstorm.
notes: From `event_black_lotus_siege`, which calls it both a camp and a fort. `Fort` is used here because the event describes scaling cliffs into it. Held by the Naga-Raja, and where Varna and Rathak were kept.

states.description: Town on the site of the old Black Lotus pirate camp that Varna drowned in flood and fire. Western rail junction.
